posts.hook: Microsoft's CEO says treat every AI model as already compromised
posts.caption: nadella says to assume ai models are compromised and wants containment, audits and tamper-proof evidence, japan's cyber chief calls the wave of corporate breaches a state of emergency, let's encrypt is shortening certificate lifetimes. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Nadella: ==assume AI models are compromised== and contain them
slides.desc: He wants observed models that leave tamper-proof, human-readable evidence.

slides.title: Japan's cyber chief calls it a state of emergency after 20+ company attacks
slides.desc: Rail group JR East and car rental firms are among those disclosing data leaks.

slides.title: Let's Encrypt is moving to ==64-day== certificate lifetimes in 2027
slides.desc: Sites without automated renewal will break more often.

terms.gloss: free certificate authority behind most of the web's https padlocks

slides.title: Agents are turning compiled games back into browser clones
slides.desc: One FPS decompile took 500+ billion tokens, a rough price of the practice.

terms.gloss: turn a finished program back into readable source code

slides.title: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to buy open-model startup Reflection AI
slides.desc: A buyer would take over the West's answer to Chinese open-weight models.
